messages:
joel: Hey team, quick onboarding snag. My laptop pickup is scheduled for Day 1 afternoon but the security micro-training is in the morning and the phishsim cohort enrolls based on training completion. Can I reschedule the training to before pickup or is there a workaround?

people-ops: Hi @joel :wave:, congrats and welcome. We can move the security micro-training to an earlier slot for you. Do you need AM or weekend? Also note: phishsim enrollment usually triggers after training completion, but we can manually enroll you earlier if needed.

joel: Morning would be great. I'm remote in PST and the scheduled training is at 2pm PT which conflicts with pickup shipping window.

security: @joel we can boot a pre-enroll for phishsim so you don't miss the cohort. For training, we can send the micro-training link and mark it as completed when you submit the short quiz. Please confirm your preferred time and we'll adjust.

it-ops: For laptop pickup: if you choose AM training, we can hold the device at facilities and do sign-out anytime after 10am PT. If you need same-day shipping to a non-standard address, we need manager approval.

joel: Thanks all. AM training works. Please send the link and I'll take it by 9:30am PT. I'll ask my manager for the shipping address approval if needed.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: joel added to "newhires-flex" cohort. First simulated phish will be delivered ~3 business days after training completion.

people-ops: Done — training rescheduled and pre-enrollment for phishsim noted. We'll DM pickup tracking once facilities confirm. :thumbsup:
